description: Header file defining the NotificationHost class, which implements the INarratorAnnouncementHost interface to announce Narrator notifications using Windows UI Automation APIs in the Calculator app.

classes.name: NotificationHost
classes.description: A sealed class implementing INarratorAnnouncementHost to handle narrator announcement notifications via Windows UI Automation.

methods.name: IsHostAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the notification host is available.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the notification host.

methods.name: GetWindowsNotificationKind
methods.description: Converts a custom AutomationNotificationKind to Windows-specific AutomationNotificationKind.

methods.name: GetWindowsNotificationProcessing
methods.description: Converts a custom AutomationNotificationProcessing to Windows-specific AutomationNotificationProcessing.
